name: VW Golf Variant VIII
note: Launch version 2020–2024 (Life 1.5 TSI, not Alltrack/R). L 4633 and W 1789 are in the VW press kit; H 1498 is WITH roof rails (press kit: 1455 without rails). Wheelbase 2669 per VW technical data (VW brochure 04/2024, auto-data, autotijd, l'argus); the VW press kit text states 2686 – disagreement between VW's own documents. Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND: VW publishes only overhang angles (13.5°/12°); l'argus, auto-data, autotijd and the VW brochure have no overhang – fo/ro null, only the sum is known (L − wb = 1964). Tracks 1533/1503 are the base-wheel values (range to 1549/1519 with wider wheels). Wm 2073 from auto-data only. Facelift 2024: L 4631 (R-Line 4638), H max 1487 (VW brochure).

name: Škoda Superb Combi IV
note: Essence/Selection trims. L, W, H, wb and tracks are from Škoda's official technical data sheet (11. 3. 2024); H 1482 is 'at kerb weight', the sheet does not say whether roof rails are included. Overhangs 950/1111 are from auto-data and autotijd (agree; 950 + 2841 + 1111 = 4902 exactly) – not seen in an official Škoda document. Wm 2090 from auto-data and autotijd. The plug-in hybrid has tracks 1584/1571 and H 1483.

name: Ford Focus IV Turnier (estate)
note: Pre-facelift estate 2018–2021 (Trend/Titanium, not Active/ST). Overhangs 909/1059 and tracks 1572/1566 agree in auto-data and angurten (909 + 2700 + 1059 = 4668 exactly). H 1494 is WITH roof rails and antenna (Ford Germany technical data, same value for the facelift Titanium Turnier); auto-data lists 1459–1469, which disagrees and is not used. W 1825 without mirrors, 1979 with mirrors, 1848 mirrors folded (Ford). Facelift 2022: L 4672 (ST-Line 4672, ST 4675, Active 4693) – facelift overhangs only found for ST (913/1062).

name: Toyota Corolla Touring Sports (E210)
note: 1.8/2.0 Hybrid, not GR Sport (4660) or Trek. All values from Toyota UK media technical specifications; 935 + 2700 + 1015 = 4650 exactly (2025 sheet, same in auto-data and autotijd). Small disagreement: the 2022 Toyota sheet gives rear overhang 1018 with L 4650, and ADAC/angurten give L 4653 with 1018. H 1435 from the 2022 sheet, auto-data and ADAC; the 2025 Toyota sheet lists 1460 (probably incl. antenna) – roof rails not specified in any source. Wm 2090 from ADAC only.

name: Peugeot 308 SW III
note: Phase I 2021–2025, 1.2 PureTech 130 / 1.5 BlueHDi. Three databases agree on all values (904 + 2732 + 1000 = 4636 exactly); no official Peugeot document was fetched. H 1444 (auto-data, autotijd; angurten 1442, hybrid 1450) – sources do not say whether roof rails are included. Rear track 1553 with 16-inch wheels (1554 on other versions). Phase II (2025–) is listed only with rounded figures 4640 × 1850, wb 2730, no overhangs.

name: BMW 3 Series Touring (G21)
note: 320i Touring, pre-LCI 2019–2022. L/W/H, wheelbase, tracks 1573/1588 and tyre are from the BMW press specification sheet (11/2019). Overhangs 799/1059 are from auto-data and angurten (799 + 2851 + 1059 = 4709 exactly) – not in the BMW sheet. Wm 2068 from auto-data, autotijd, angurten. No roof-rail remark in the BMW sheet (height 'unladen'). Track values in databases disagree with BMW (auto-data 1579/1569, autotijd 1587/1604, angurten 1571/1589) – BMW sheet used. LCI 2022–: L 4713, front overhang 803 (auto-data), rear 1059.

name: Volvo V60 II
note: Standard V60 (not Cross Country), 2018–2022 body. L, W, Wm, H, wb and tracks are from Volvo's 2019 V60 specification sheet (copy hosted by Volvo Owners Club); H 1427 includes the shark-fin antenna, at kerb weight + 1 person, no roof-rail remark. Tracks per Volvo: 1610 (16"), 1603 (17"), 1600 (18"/19"), 1593 (20") front and rear – 1600 given to match the 18-inch tyre. Overhangs 848/1041 agree in auto-data, autotijd and angurten (848 + 2872 + 1041 = 4761 exactly) – not in the Volvo sheet. Later model years are listed by Volvo with L 4778 and H 1432; overhang split for that length not found.

name: Škoda Kamiq
note: All dimensions including both overhangs and width with mirrors are printed on the dimension drawing of Škoda's official technical data sheet dated 9. 1. 2024 (facelift, Essence/Selection): 837 + 2651 + 753 = 4241 exactly. Same values in auto-data and autotijd for 2019–2023, so the facelift did not change them. H 1531 is 'at kerb weight'; auto-data lists 1553 for some versions (probably with roof rails) – not stated officially. auto-data's facelift pages list wb 2639 and H 1562, which contradicts the Škoda sheet and is not used. Tyre 205/60 R16 from auto-data.

name: VW T-Roc I (A11)
note: Launch version 2017–2021, front-wheel drive. L, W (without mirrors), H, wheelbase, both overhangs and both tracks are quoted in VW's official world-premiere press kit (08/2017): 831 + 2603 + 800 = 4234 exactly. Important disagreement: VW's later technical data (auto-data, autotijd) list wheelbase 2590 and tracks 1538/1533 (range to 1546/1541) – the press-kit set is used because it is the only one with overhangs and is self-consistent. Roof rails not mentioned for H 1573. Wm 1992 from auto-data and autotijd. Facelift 2022–2025: L 4236, H 1584, Wm 2012; overhangs for the facelift not found.

name: Renault Captur II
note: Phase 1, 2019–2024. Three databases agree (876 + 2639 + 712 = 4227 exactly); no official Renault document was fetched. H 1576 (early 2019 versions listed with 1585) – roof rails not specified. Rear track 1547 (early diesel versions 1544). Facelift 2024–: L 4239, H 1575, front overhang 883, rear 717, tracks 1562/1547, Wm 2003–2004 (auto-data and autotijd agree; 883 + 2639 + 717 = 4239).

name: Nissan Qashqai III (J12)
note: 2WD 1.3 DIG-T with 17-inch alloys and torsion-beam rear axle; same body dimensions before and after the 2024 facelift. All values from Nissan's owner's manual and Nissan UK dimensions page. H 1625 INCLUDES the antenna (1610 without antenna); roof rails not mentioned. Tracks per Nissan: front 1590 (17"/20") or 1580 (18"/19"); rear beam axle 1590/1580, rear multi-link 1596/1586. Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND in any source (Nissan manual, Nissan UK, press release, auto-data, autotijd, angurten, ADAC) – fo/ro null, only the sum is known (L − wb = 1760). The 903/845 figures seen on cararac belong to the previous J11.

name: VW Tiguan III
note: 1.5 eTSI / 2.0 TDI front-wheel drive, not R-Line (W 1859). L, W, H and wb from the VW UK press pack (04/2024) data table; the press text rounds the wheelbase to 2680, the eHybrid is 2679 with H 1658. Roof rails not mentioned for H. Tracks 1586/1578 from auto-data (lower bound of range) and autotijd; Wm 2140 from auto-data, autotijd, angurten. Front and rear overhang NOT FOUND: not in the VW press kit, UK press pack, auto-data, autotijd, angurten or carexpert – fo/ro null, only the sum is known (L − wb = 1863).

name: Kia Sportage V (NQ5, Europe)
note: European short-wheelbase body, pre-facelift 2021–2025. L, W, H, wb, both overhangs and the standard tyre are from Kia's official European specification sheet (905 + 2680 + 930 = 4515 exactly); auto-data and autotijd agree. H 1645 per Kia (auto-data/ADAC list 1650, probably with roof rails – not stated). Tracks are NOT in the Kia sheet: 1615/1622 from autotijd and auto-data, where the range is 1615–1630 front / 1622–1637 rear depending on wheel size; which value belongs to the 17-inch wheel is not verified (on the related Hyundai Tucson the 17-inch wheel has the wider 1630/1637). Wm 2085 from ADAC only (auto-data says 2080). angurten's overhangs 910/900 do not add up to the length and are ignored. Facelift 2025–: L 4540, overhangs 930/930.

name: Hyundai Tucson IV (NX4, Europe)
note: European short-wheelbase body, launch version 2020–2024. L, W, H, wb and both overhangs are from Hyundai's European press kit (895 + 2680 + 925 = 4500 exactly; auto-data agrees). H 1650 is WITH roof rails (Hyundai Germany data sheet; 1655 with panoramic roof). Tracks, Wm 2130 and tyre from Hyundai Germany's technical data sheet: 17-inch 1630/1637, 18/19-inch 1615/1622. Later versions keep the wheelbase and rear overhang but have longer noses: facelift 2024 L 4510 with front overhang 905 (angurten), model year 2026 L 4525 with 920 (Hyundai Germany sheet; N Line rear 935).

name: Toyota RAV4 V (XA50)
note: 2.5 Hybrid (European body), not Plug-in/GR Sport/Adventure. All values except Wm are from Toyota UK media technical specifications (2022, 2023 and 2024 sheets identical): 910 + 2690 + 1000 = 4600 exactly; autotijd agrees. Disagreement on the split: auto-data (and autotijd for GR Sport) list overhangs 925/985, which also add up to 4600 – the Toyota sheet is used. H 1685; roof rails not specified. Wm 2160 from ADAC only.

name: Kia Sorento IV (MQ4)
note: Pre-facelift 2020–2024 (hybrid/diesel). L, W, H, wb and overhangs 930/1065 are from Kia's official specification table (kia.com, Sorento Hybrid MQ4): 930 + 2815 + 1065 = 4810 exactly; autotijd (European 2020–2024) and auto-data agree. H 1695 is WITHOUT the roof rack; Kia gives 1700 with roof rack (without antenna). Tracks 1646/1656 (19-inch) from autotijd and auto-data; Wm 2170 from auto-data and autotijd. Facelift 2024–: L 4815, overhangs 925/1075 (Kia Ireland brochure, autotijd, angurten).
